themes.lane: general-purpose starter and documentation sites
themes.notes: Shared runtime and base theme that every child theme extends; owns the canonical navigation and footer chrome.

themes.lane: creative case-study and talent-discovery platforms
themes.notes: Token set is identical to the other illustrated-media portfolio premiums (character-portfolio-index, portfolio-directory, premium-portfolio-collection, one-page-showcase); differentiation lives almost entirely in section names and accent colour.

themes.lane: curated creator and portfolio recommendation indexes
themes.notes: Thin variant of portfolio-directory / premium-portfolio-collection: same token values except accent and surface colours, and the same curated-grid concept; merge candidate.

themes.lane: creative culture magazines and studio journals
themes.notes: Differs from design-led-magazine only by accent/surface colours, illustrated vs photographic media, and section labels; strongest merge candidate in the magazine cluster.

themes.lane: dark-mode product-led SaaS and workflow platforms
themes.notes: Only dark theme and only SaaS-lane theme in the catalogue; unique surface/foreground inversion despite sharing the common token schema.

themes.lane: news publishers and analysis desks
themes.notes: News lane is the clearest of the magazine cluster, but tokens are identical to design-led-magazine and global-culture-magazine bar colours; needs denser layout tokens to earn its name.

themes.lane: design, architecture and interiors magazines
visualDifferentiators: oxblood accent on warm paper surface
themes.notes: Overlaps heavily with global-culture-magazine and creative-culture-editorial; sections differ but token values are colour-swaps of the same preset.

themes.lane: long-form print-voice publications and essayists
audience: Any site wanting a print-grade serif voice
themes.notes: Only child theme that reuses foundation navigation/footer chrome and the only serif-first token set; strong distinct print-editorial lane within the publishing family.

themes.lane: award-style creative-industry directories and submission galleries
themes.notes: Shares its condensed/sharp/dense token skeleton and awards vocabulary with motion-archive; distinct media treatment but the two lanes should be pulled further apart.

themes.lane: large multi-taxonomy inspiration and reference libraries
themes.notes: Filter/taxonomy lane is distinct within the gallery cluster, but competes directly with landing-gallery and quiet-web-gallery for the same inspiration-library buyer.

themes.lane: global affairs, travel and culture magazines with audio
themes.notes: Audio/travel sections give it a real lane, but the visual preset is a colour-swap of design-led-magazine and dense-news-analysis; needs distinct typography or density.

themes.lane: landing-page and SaaS template showcase galleries
themes.notes: Screenshot-first treatment and paid-templates sections distinguish it, but it overlaps one-page-showcase's template-gallery lane almost exactly at the audience level.

themes.lane: modern service sites and product launches
themes.notes: The free showcase theme; only theme with an overlayTreatment token and a presets section, giving it a clear glass identity distinct from foundation.

themes.lane: daily screenshot and app-reference curation feeds
visualDifferentiators: plain white surface with blue accent
themes.notes: System-font hairline minimalism reads genuinely different from the gallery-cluster siblings, but the curation-feed lane still competes with filter-gallery and quiet-web-gallery.

themes.lane: digital awards archives with motion previews and jury scores
themes.notes: Shares the condensed/sharp/dense skeleton with experimental-directory and the awards vocabulary with scoreboard-showcase; motion-preview treatment is its main differentiator.

themes.lane: one-page website and template galleries
themes.notes: Token-identical to the illustrated portfolio group and audience-adjacent to landing-gallery; the one-page angle is the thinnest differentiator in the gallery cluster.

themes.lane: designer and developer portfolio directories with career resources
themes.notes: Career-resources angle is useful, but tokens and structure mirror premium-portfolio-collection and character-portfolio-index; the three should be differentiated or consolidated.

themes.lane: awarded portfolio directories and design education hubs
themes.notes: Anchor of the illustrated portfolio group; portfolio-directory and character-portfolio-index are near-clones of it, differing mainly in accent colour and section labels.

themes.lane: calm, understated web design inspiration galleries
visualDifferentiators: muted sage accent on stone surface
themes.notes: The calm/muted styling gives it a tone-of-voice niche, but it serves the same inspiration-gallery buyer as filter-gallery and minimal-curation-feed.

themes.lane: underground culture zines and experimental archives
themes.notes: Only mono/brutalist token set in the catalogue; unmistakable zine identity keeps it clear of the other archive-directory themes despite similar section anatomy.

themes.lane: design awards, nominations and judged voting galleries
themes.notes: Live-voting/scoring mechanics distinguish it from motion-archive's historical-awards lane, but the two awards themes court the same buyer and warrant coordinated positioning.
